raw: {"text": "Signature required: FedEx left a door tag on your house yesterday. You must sign the tag or pick up the package at their depot."}
{"text": "Your GigaWidget was dispatched with tracking number TRK-44910. We’re sending a replacement today and expect delivery by November 5. Please let us know if it arrives."}

{"text": "Two-factor authentication requires your authenticator app and recovery codes. If you deleted the app without saving backups, please use the recovery codes we provided. We can’t restore your account. "}
{"text": "Your account is blocked due to exceeding your API limit. To continue, you’ll need to upgrade to the Enterprise plan and pay for increased bandwidth."}
{"text": "You were double charged. I’ve processed Refund-909. Expect 3-5 business days for your bank to reflect the refund. No worries—please don’t email tomorrow."}
{"text": "We understand your concern. The Auto-renew was turned off in October, and I’ve disabled it for you. Your access will expire at the end of October. Goodbye."}
{"text": "Your account is suspended because you violated our Terms of Service. You can submit a formal appeal through the legal link at the bottom of the page."}
{"text": "We can only offer an exchange only at Store 42 using your gift receipt. Please bring it in person—cash isn't available. Thank you for your understanding."}

{"text": "The serial number on the device you returned doesn’t match the one we sold. The seal is broken, so the voided warranty applies. The Return Dept will send this item back to you. Please contact us if you have questions."}
{"text": "Your request for RMA-77 is denied because returns must be requested within 14 days of purchase. A restocking fee applies. Please retain the item and review our policy next time."}
{"text": "The item is in worn condition. Under Policy 4B, we can offer store credit. Please contact us for details."}

{"text": "We're sorry—this item is backordered due to a supplier delay. We won't have stock until at least January. Please choose between waiting or canceling the order. No further updates are available."}

{"text": "You arrived without completing the Intake form we emailed three days ago. Please sit in the waiting room and fill it out on your phone now. We won’t call your name until it’s submitted. Dr. Vance will continue seeing other patients promptly. Please review the instructions we send."}
{"text": "We’re sorry—your Custom Mug is damaged. We’ll send a replacement and expect delivery by December 1."}
{"text": "Dear Jane Doe, your meeting was rescheduled for Tuesday. Please confirm your attendance by Tuesday. Confirmation #882 is attached. Thank you for your prompt attention."}
{"text": "You cancelled early, so a prorated refund of $12.50 has been issued for the unused days. The refund is final—please close this conversation."}
{"text": "The promotional code SAVE20 has expired. Please use a valid code for your order."}
{"text": "Your order was returned to sender because the address for Apartment 4B was missing. We’ll reship it once received, and the extra shipping fee will be charged to your account."}
{"text": "Our security protocol requires password resets via email to help@example.com from your registered address—this process takes 24 hours. Please refrain from spamming this chat. Thank you."}
{"text": "Sorry, the Consultation was rescheduled via Zoom link. Please reschedule at your earliest convenience."}
{"text": "Merging accounts may risk data loss. A System Admin will handle this one time. Please avoid this in the future."}
{"text": "You were 15 minutes late to the meeting. Our policy requires rescheduling. You’ve been automatically rescheduled for next Friday at the same time. Please plan accordingly."}
{"text": "Yes, the site is slow due to a DDoS attack targeting 192.0.2.100. Our team is running mitigation protocols."}
{"text": "We’re sorry—our monthly subscription caused an overdraft. Please contact your bank to address this. We’re unable to cover fees. Please cancel your plan if needed."}
{"text": "Node 7 is unresponsive and traffic to 203.0.113.10 is timing out. Our team is rebooting the cluster. Please wait a few minutes and try logging in again later."}

{"text": "Dear Dr. Allen, we’re sorry for the inconvenience. Due to the cancellation with less than two hours’ notice, we’re applying a $50 cancellation fee. The amount has been charged to your card on file. Please contact us if you have questions. Thank you."}
{"text": "I’m unable to process a downgrade to Premium Tier. The change takes effect on the next billing cycle. Please review your plan details."}

{"text": "Thank you for purchasing a digital download. The license key has been provided. Unfortunately, there are no refunds for digital goods. We are closing this ticket. Please contact us if you have other questions."}
{"text": "To change your username, please go to the Settings tab and click edit. If issues persist, contact admin@example.org."}
{"text": "Your refund for INV-992 of $14.50 will be processed by October 12."}
{"text": "Our Technician is between 8 AM and 12 PM and has been dispatched. Please stay home and wait. They will arrive soon."}
{"text": "Your customized item with engraving is a final sale. We cannot process returns, as it is marked as final sale. Please consider gifting it instead."}
{"text": "The late fee of $5.00 for invoice BLL-1002 is applied because payment was delayed. Please settle this promptly."}
{"text": "Server Alpha is currently unavailable at 192.0.2.55. We expect the issue to resolve in 4 hours."}
{"text": "You're receiving an error 404. Please clear your cache. For support, visit support.example.net."}
{"text": "Your order was shipped via standard ground instead of Expedited Shipping. We’ve refunded $15.00. Thank you for your patience."}
{"text": "Unfortunately, Dr. Smith had an unexpected commitment on August 20 at 2:30 PM and cannot attend. We regret any inconvenience. Would you like us to reschedule for that time?"}
{"text": "The system is offline for maintenance during the Sunday 2 AM maintenance window. Please check back online later. Thank you for your patience."}
{"text": "Please avoid editing your profile right now. The database migration was announced three times—we’re in read-only mode until midnight."}
